title: podophyllum grayi
intro: Podophyllum grayi, commonly known as Spigelia, is a plant species belonging to the family Loganiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include its use in treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Spigelia are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, which help in reducing fever and relieving pain. The bioactive constituents of Spigelia include alkaloids like spigelin, spigelia alkaloids, and lignans, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
